tldr: A second wave of refrigeration-system attacks hit 100+ European supermarkets, spoiling food stocks, while Binance attributed its record $6.43B crypto theft to a North Korea-linked, AI-assisted campaign. Two vulnerabilities under active exploitation — a WordPress core flaw and a Siemens Node-RED bug — need urgent patching, alongside fresh breaches at Florida's student aid system, Chainstack, and a hijacked Linux update channel.

emerging.title: Refrigeration cyberattacks spread to 100+ European stores
emerging.description: A novel OT attack vector: a second wave hit internet-exposed refrigeration/cooling controllers across multiple European countries, forcing supermarkets to discard spoiled food. CERT-SE confirms Swedish entities affected.

emerging.title: Binance: $6.43B theft used AI tools and fake job interviews
emerging.description: Binance says a North Korea-linked, months-long campaign began with a trojanized Homebrew installer and fake job interviews targeting two engineers, then used AI tooling in the operation — a notable escalation in AI-assisted social engineering/supply-chain tactics.

items.title: CISA: WordPress core flaw actively exploited during upgrades
items.description: CVE-2026-119977 was added to CISA's KEV catalog on Nov 3 after confirmed attacks exploiting the flaw to run code during WordPress core upgrades. Federal agencies face a patch deadline.

items.title: Siemens IoT2050 Node-RED flaw under active attack
items.description: A maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) missing-authentication bug (CVE-2026-58115) in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Node-RED interfaces is being exploited to deploy Linux bots and webshells. Update to V4.3.4.1+.

items.title: C3RB3R ransomware hits Synology NAS over patched DSM flaw
items.description: Ransomware actors are targeting Synology DSM devices still unpatched against a flaw fixed in late 2024, encrypting files with a .L0CK3D extension. Synology urges updating DSM and removing internet exposure.

items.title: Florida student financial aid breach hits 4.9 million people
items.description: Florida's Dept. of Education says unauthorized access to its student financial aid website, discovered Oct 19 and newly quantified this week, may have exposed Social Security numbers of ~4.9M applicants.

items.title: Google dismantles 1.3M-device Android TV box botnet
items.description: Google and partners took down the XCPE botnet, built by an Android device maker and run as a profit-driven proxy network across 1.3 million Android TV boxes worldwide.

items.title: cPGuard update channel hijacked to backdoor Linux servers
items.description: An attacker used compromised credentials to push a malicious script through cPGuard's update system, installing a backdoor and harvesting password hashes on affected Linux servers.

items.title: UK cyber chief warns of "unprecedented rise" in attacks, AI threats by 2028
items.description: NCSC's chief says the UK will face a sharp near-term rise in cyberattacks and expects AI-driven attacks on critical infrastructure from criminals and states, including China and Russia, by 2028.

items.title: German lawmakers warned by Apple of spyware targeting
items.description: Several German federal lawmakers and foreign-policy staff received Apple threat notifications warning their devices may have been targeted with mercenary spyware.

items.title: Chainstack discloses production breach exposing customer data
items.description: Blockchain infrastructure provider Chainstack says an attacker moved from a development environment into parts of production, exposing customer data and password hashes. ⚠️ Could not independently confirm via a second outlet.

items.title: Russia-aligned "Gorbag" group exploits WinRAR flaw against Ukraine
items.description: A newly named Russia-linked group is using a WinRAR vulnerability as an entry point to deploy data-stealing malware against Ukrainian organizations. ⚠️ Group name/attribution not yet corroborated outside this report.

action: Patch immediately: WordPress core (CVE-2026-119977, actively exploited via plugin upgrades), Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050/Node-RED (CVE-2026-58115 — update to V4.3.4.1+ or disable the exposed HTTP interface), and Synology DSM (update and remove DSM from direct internet exposure; C3RB3R ransomware is actively targeting unpatched systems). If running cPGuard, verify update-channel integrity and rotate credentials/password hashes on affected hosts. If you operate internet-exposed refrigeration/cooling or other OT controllers, isolate them from the internet and review remote-access configurations given the ongoing European attack wave.
